target.title: policy: repair automatic narrowing findings
target.body:
## Summary  - add automatic policy repair helpers for the first safe narrowing slice - wire repair handlers only for:   - `policy/tools-elevated-enabled`   - `policy/gateway-control-ui-insecure`   - `policy/gateway-remote-enabled`   - `policy/data-handling-redaction-disabled`   - `policy/data-handling-telemetry-content-capture` - keep review-required/manual findings detect-only - preserve policy repair safety by requiring `plugins.entries.policy.config.workspaceRepairs=true` - avoid over-applying scoped elevated findings globally and repair remote gateway posture through `gateway.remote.enabled=false`  ## Validation  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts --reporter=dot` (288 tests) - `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm exec oxlint extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` - `git diff --check` - `codex review --base origin/policy-doctor-fix-rules` (clean after fixing accepted findings)  ## Not run  - `pnpm tsgo:core` remains blocked in this local worktree by pre-existing untracked `src/oc-path/` files with unused-symbol errors.  ## Stack  Stacked on #99686 (`policy: classify doctor fix recommendations`), which is stacked on #99121 (`policy: cover gateway node commands`). Rebase onto `main` after the lower stack lands.## Real behavior proofBehavior or issue addressed:`doctor --fix` safely applies the first automatic policy narrowing repairs only when `workspaceRepairs=true`, covering elevated tools, insecure gateway control UI, remote gateway mode, disabled redaction, and telemetry content capture.Real environment tested:Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on the restacked policy series, top head `7aebf26a24` and this PR head `7341a15e7c`. This is a source-harness proof; it does not start a packaged OpenClaw binary or make live LLM calls.Exact steps or command run after this patch:1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`3. `pnpm tsgo:extensions`4. `pnpm lint:extensions`5. `git diff --check`
6. `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json`Evidence after fix:The focused policy/core/CLI/tooling Vitest run passed 10 core repair-flow tests, 7 SDK surface tooling tests, 13 policy CLI tests, and 334 policy doctor/doctor-lint tests, including `repairs automatic policy narrowing config findings` and no-repair behavior without the workspace repair opt-in. `tsgo:extensions`, `lint:extensions`, `git diff --check`, and `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json` all exited 0.Observed result after fix:Automatic policy narrowing repairs mutate only the exact config paths reported by policy findings and keep review-required/manual findings detect-only.What was not tested:No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.
